title.rendered: STREAMS OF JOY DEVOTIONAL- SPEEDY RESULTS

excerpt.rendered: “Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.” (Luke 8: 44)That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy…

content.rendered: “Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.” (Luke 8: 44)That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.The woman with the issue of blood touched the hem of Jesus’ garment, and immediately, her issue of blood came to an end. She touched the hem of Jesus’ garment, and her trouble disappeared immediately. Her result did not wait for a while before it manifested; it happened immediately. Her result was not delayed; it came quickly. Her issue of blood received speedy attention. She received a speedy result.Friend, hear me as I hear the Lord: this is your season of speedy results. Your results will manifest speedily; your congratulations will come speedily; doors will open to you speedily; opportunities will come to you speedily; miracles will locate you with speed; the helpers you need will come to you with speed; the resources you need will come to you with speed; the events of your life will move from the slow lane to the speed lane.In this season, opportunities for relevance and influence will come to you speedily; clients that will cause your business to rise higher will come to you speedily; the greatness you seek to attain will become your reality speedily; the results that took others long years to achieve will become your reality speedily; you will be counted among those whose lives are filled with tales of speedy results; your testimony shall be that of speedy results.The days of being on the slow lane in life, are over; the days of remaining at the same spot for long, are over; the days of waiting for so long before the next set of results show up, are over; the days of waiting for so long before your testimonies arrive, are over; the days of delays and stagnation are over; the days of waiting endlessly for good news, are over; the days of slow movements and advancement, are over.Welcome to your season of speedy results. Get set for results that will show up faster than you bargained for.Psalm 90: 14 says: “O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.”Declare With Me: It’s my season of speedy results, in Jesus’ name!Follow on Instagram @jerry_ezeFollow on Twitter @jerrystreams
